name: Task Titans
summary:
Task Titans is a series of 3 virtual reality mini games intended to teach the player project management concepts. 

Defeat Gremlins:
Overcome risks and issues by battling gremlins, enhancing your problem-solving skills.

Bridge Building: 
Construct one of multiples bridges types,  applying project management principles to ensure success.

Resource Management & Team Coordination:
Manage resources wisely and work with a team to bring your bridge project to completion.

Learn Valuable Life Skills:
Gain insight
